paper: Paper V - Verified Discovery in Mathematics
authority: Same-context analysis. No scientific or promotion authority.
object: The scientific object and headline question of Paper V under the 2026 research-level mathematics frontier.
current_question: Can a five-coordinate assurance architecture make LLM-mediated mathematical research auditable, with verified checkpointing turning generator error into search cost and with prospective verified-discovery performance?
frontier_update: Research-level proof/search capability is no longer an empty space: Aletheia (arXiv:2602.10177) reports end-to-end research-agent milestones.
Formal Conjectures (arXiv:2605.13171) supplies a large evolving Lean research-level benchmark with open and solved statements.
Strong formal-search parents include BFS-Prover, HTPS, DeepSeek-Prover-V2 and AlphaProof-family systems.
problem_with_current_question: LLM mediation is an implementation choice, not the durable mathematical object.
Proof-search ability and research-promotion assurance are distinct: a strong prover may be unsafe to promote, while a cautious assurance layer may be expensive without increasing theorem yield.
The phrase verified discovery can invite theorem-truth authority to stand in for specification fidelity, novelty, value or verifier trust even though the manuscript formally separates them.

candidate_questions.question: What executor-independent evidence contract is sufficient to promote a machine-generated mathematical result into a research record as the intended result, while specification alignment, theorem truth, novelty, research value and verifier trust remain separate noncompensatory coordinates?
candidate_questions.why: This remains meaningful as proposer capability changes and differentiates RAKL from proof search itself.
falsifiers: valid intended results are systematically blocked
a planted wrong-spec/false/untrusted result can be promoted
one coordinate is silently inferred from another

candidate_questions.question: Does the full promotion contract reduce unauthorized research promotion beyond simpler proof-checker/statement-binding parents while retaining legitimate promotions at acceptable cost?
candidate_questions.why: Reject-all is not success; utility requires both safety and recall plus cost.

candidate_questions.question: How should verifier/trusted-computing-base changes alter mathematical authority without rewriting theorem history?
candidate_questions.why: A proof may remain derivationally valid relative to an old checker while trust in that path changes; this links Paper V to the evaluator-governance machinery without collapsing them.

candidate_questions.question: What theorem-yield/search-cost frontier is induced by the assurance layer under strong formal-search parents?
candidate_questions.why: Measures the tax/benefit of verification but does not define the research-promotion claim.
candidate_questions.existing_lane: VTG/verified-search work remains governed by its own strongest-parent packet.

candidate_questions.question: Do promotion semantics remain invariant when the proposal source is replaced by a substantially different neural or symbolic executor?
candidate_questions.why: Turns executor independence into an observed system property rather than wording.

recommended_headline_question.statement: What must be true before a machine-generated mathematical result may be promoted into the research record, and does enforcing that product contract prevent invalid intended-result promotion without degenerating into reject-all or prohibitive cost?
recommended_headline_question.paper_title_direction: Verified Mathematical Discovery: Executor-Independent Research Promotion under Specification, Proof, Novelty and Verifier Trust
recommended_headline_question.why_better: It targets the research-authority boundary rather than competing with rapidly improving proof search, makes the five-coordinate product falsifiable, and naturally requires valid-positive controls, hostile attacks and explicit cost.

minimum_evidence_program: Mechanize the minimum product/noninterference/dependency-closure nucleus in Lean with no sorry/unregistered axioms.

Freeze a hostile known-answer benchmark containing wrong-spec, false theorem, forbidden-axiom/trust, hash substitution, dependency omission, rediscovery/equivalence and CANNOT_CHECK cases plus valid positives.
Compare monolithic model, proof-checker-only, proof+exact-statement parent, and full RAKL assurance.
Run the same promotion engine with at least one substantially different/LLM-free proposer.
Keep proof-search/VTG benefit as a separately interpreted cost/performance coordinate.

publication_branching.safety_positive_recall_positive: Strong assurance paper independent of theorem-solving SOTA.
publication_branching.safety_positive_recall_poor: Overblocking architecture; narrow to formal safety result and repair admission/abstention semantics before claiming useful discovery.
publication_branching.false_promotion_found: Promotion contract is incomplete; preserve counterexample and repair the earliest missing coordinate/gate.
publication_branching.assurance_parent_matches: Narrow novelty to whichever coordinate/attack full RAKL uniquely handles; do not sell the entire stack.
publication_branching.search_cost_dominates: Assurance may still be scientifically valid but not practically advantageous under the tested regime; report the cost boundary.

must_not_claim: Novelty because a theorem is not in a benchmark.
Verifier trust from a passing proof alone.
VTG/search benefit before strongest-parent fully-costed evidence.
Executor independence without proposer replacement evidence.
closest_parent_identifiers: Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research / Aletheia arXiv:2602.10177
